history.summary: A freehold 1,323 sqft 4BR at $1.8M / $1,361 PSF on Changi Road, D14, just 50m from Kembangan MRT. Outstanding transit and freehold tenure at a reasonable quantum, but the project is identified only by street name with no built_year and zero URA appreciation/transaction/median data — almost certainly a small freehold walk-up block (the Changi Road strip holds 40-80-unit projects), which means thin, lumpy liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: The 50m walk to Kembangan MRT and freehold tenure at $1,361 PSF / $1.8M are genuinely strong, and the value-frontier flag reflects efficient pricing. But the complete absence of built_year and any URA series — plus a street-name 'project' that maps to small walk-up blocks — leaves liquidity and appreciation unverifiable. The high score is partly an artifact of missing data scoring neutral. Strong location pulls it up to Neutral, but the data gaps prevent a Buy.
